links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified abstracts and patient education materials (before vs after GPT-4 transformation)
links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level and Flesch Reading Ease) and content fidelity
links.effect: FKGL fell from 12th to 5th grade for abstracts and from 13th to 5th for PEMs (p < 0.001); FKRE improved similarly (p < 0.001). Mean LSA cosine similarity was 0.746 for abstracts and 0.953 for PEMs. Expert-rated mean topic similarity was 0.775 for abstracts and 0.715 for PEMs.
links.tradeoff: Some content was not preserved: expert topic similarity was 0.775 for abstracts and 0.715 for PEMs. LSA overestimated similarity for longer texts (correlation with experts -0.167 for PEMs; -0.20 above 450 words). The authors say expert validation is crucial.
links.quote: FKGL decreased from 12th to 5th grade for abstracts and 13th to 5th for PEMs (p < 0.001).

design_hint: reading-level constraint in prompt with content fidelity checks
